text:
maria: Report inbound from the assessor team. I've uploaded the PDF + raw logs to the evidence bucket (link in thread). We need owners for any P1/P2s and a short remediation note by EOD tomorrow.

jason: On it. I'll run a quick grep to map findings touching `kms:` and any IAM roles. Expect a dependency note in the spreadsheet.

sam: Created a minimal triage sheet (cols: id, sev, svc, owner, blocker, eta, evidence-link). Sharing: https://tiny.redwood/pt-triage-2024. Please add rows as you assign.

maria: Triage rules: P1 (critical) = fix before retest, no partial. P2 (high) = patch + canary, aim for retest. P3+ = document mitigations + schedule. Evidence bundle required for each remediated item.

lee: Two entries reference unconstrained decrypt on a shared analytics key (findings A3, A4). Short mitigation: restrict key policy to analytics-role ARN and add an explicit deny for `kms:Decrypt` unless request originates from VPC endpoints.

jason: Found references in `infra/kms/keys.tf` and `services/analytics/iam.tf`. I'll open a PR to adjust key policy and add a `Condition` on `aws:SourceVpc`.

sam: For ephemeral access to the assessor, propose using STS sessions via a short TTL role and pre-signed session tokens. Draft policy snippet in the sheet. Also adding `context:assessor=true` tag requirement so we can filter in logs.

maria: Yes — tag requirement is good. Ensure CloudTrail captures AssumeRole events for the role and we export those. We also need KMS Grant logs exported.

security-bot: Reminder: run `scripts/collect_evidence.sh --from 2024-07-01 --to 2024-07-07 --sha-file sha.txt` after fixes to capture snapshots. Follow the evidence naming convention: `pt-<timestamp>-<finding>.tar.gz`.

jason: Quick Q: rotating analytics key might impact scheduled jobs (Airflow DAGs). @data-team will need a canary rotation strategy and a rollback plan. Who owns that?

maria: Data infra owns DAGs. I've pinged @data (added note in spreadsheet). Plan: rotate during maintenance window, update secret in vault, deploy canary to one worker pool first.

lee: For PR policy changes, propose adding a test harness: local `python kms_policy_check.py` that simulates decrypt attempts from non-VPC IPs and ensures policy denies. Include harness in CI.

jason: Good call. I'll add `make test-kms` which runs the policy linter + a simulated assume-role smoke test. If smoke fails, CI blocks merge and creates a rollback ticket.

sam: Scheduling: assessor asked for retest windows Tue 09:00-13:00 UTC and Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC. They want the read-only evidence bundle 24h beforehand. Freeze config 1h before window.

maria: Ops checklist for each P1/P2 fix:
- assign owner in sheet & Jira ticket
- PR with rollback plan and test notes
- evidence export task scheduled (CloudTrail + KMS logs + app traces)
- ephemeral assessor role created + audit enabled
- legal/reg flagged if customer keys affected
- retest slot reservation

oncall: I'll reserve the windows and create a temporary retest channel. I'll also stand up a staging bridge during the slot.

jason: Command to export CloudTrail for the evidence slice (example):

aws cloudtrail create-export-task --trail-name prod-trail --start-time 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-07-07T00:00:00Z --s3-bucket-name redwood-pt-evidence

After export, compute SHA256: `sha256sum pt-*.tar.gz > evidence.sha256`.

lee: Small mitigation PR pattern: add deny statement before allow to ensure we don't accidentally widen access. Pseudopolicy: `Deny kms:Decrypt unless aws:SourceVpc == vpc-1234 OR aws:PrincipalArn == arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/analytics`.

jason: I'll make the terraform change with a `lifecycle` block and plan in the PR so reviewers can see drift.

maria: Deadline: owners & PR links for all P1/P2s by EOD tomorrow. We'll do a 09:30 PT standup (short) to confirm blockers. If you can't make it, drop an update here.

sam: Adding Jira labels: `pen-test:critical`, `pt:needs-evidence`, `pt:retetst-slot`. Linking to the triage sheet rows.

security-bot: Meeting scheduled: "PT remediation sync" 2024-07-02T16:30Z. Attendees: maria, jason, sam, lee, oncall.

maria: If you take an owner, comment in the sheet and tag `@maria`. After evidence export, we need to populate the readroom with presigned URLs (24h expiry) and include the `evidence.sha256` file.

lee: Note: anything touching customer encryption workflows must go through compliance review. I'll flag rows where we change customer-key handling.

jason: Will also add a short runbook for the retest: how to enable verbose KMS logging and how to snapshot the KV cache.

maria: Thanks team. Let's keep updates tight in this thread. Ping me if you hit an ops or legal blocker. :white_check_mark:
